title: CERN Linac4 直線加速器
summary: 以取代 Linac2、自 2020 年起為 CERN 全部質子束流源頭的 86 m 長 Linac4 為對象，說明為何把注入能量從 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV 並改用 H⁻ 能讓 PS Booster 亮度約加倍，再把 45 keV 離子源、3 MeV RFQ、斬波線、三種 352.2 MHz 加速結構、飛行時間相位掃描、損失與剝離預算、碳膜電荷交換注入與可靠度驗收整合成可交接的加速器紀錄。
summaryEn: For the 86 m Linac4 that replaced Linac2 and since 2020 sources every proton beam at CERN, show why raising injection energy from 50 to 160 MeV with H⁻ ions roughly doubles PS Booster brightness, then integrate the 45 keV source, 3 MeV RFQ, chopper line, three 352.2 MHz accelerating structures, time-of-flight phase scans, loss and stripping budgets, carbon-foil charge-exchange injection and reliability acceptance into a transferable accelerator record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Linac4 束流鏈練習：λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m。H⁻ 在 45 keV、3、50、160 MeV 的 β 為 0.00979、0.0797、0.314、0.520，單元長度 βλ 從 8.3 mm 增到 44.2 cm（π 模 22.1 cm）。40 mA 束流的廣義導流係數由 45 keV 的 2.7×10⁻³ 降到 3 MeV 的 5.0×10⁻⁶，說明 RFQ 為何必須放在最前面。飛行時間：50 MeV、5 m 路徑 53.13 ns，0.1 MeV 改變 49 ps 即 6.2°。PSB：β·γ² 從 50 MeV 的 0.348 增到 160 MeV 的 0.712，比值 2.04；迴轉頻率 0.992 MHz，每環注入 100 µs 約 99 圈、25 mA 給 1.56×10¹³ 個質子。損失：平均功率 4.0 MW × 400 µs × 0.83 Hz = 1328 W，每公尺損失比例須小於 7.5×10⁻⁴。可用率：20 座 RF 站各 99.5% 加離子源 99% 得 0.896。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Linac4 beam-chain exercise: λ = c/352.2 MHz = 0.851 m. H⁻ at 45 keV, 3, 50 and 160 MeV has β = 0.00979, 0.0797, 0.314 and 0.520, so cell length βλ grows from 8.3 mm to 44.2 cm, or 22.1 cm for a π-mode cell. The generalised perveance of a 40 mA beam falls from 2.7×10⁻³ at 45 keV to 5.0×10⁻⁶ at 3 MeV, which is why the RFQ must come first. Time of flight: at 50 MeV a 5 m path takes 53.13 ns and a 0.1 MeV change moves it by 49 ps, or 6.2°. PSB: β·γ² rises from 0.348 at 50 MeV to 0.712 at 160 MeV, a ratio of 2.04; the revolution frequency is 0.992 MHz, so a 100 µs injection per ring spans about 99 turns and 25 mA delivers 1.56×10¹³ protons. Losses: average power 4.0 MW × 400 µs × 0.83 Hz = 1328 W, so fractional loss must stay below 7.5×10⁻⁴ per metre. Availability: 20 RF stations at 99.5% each with a 99% source give 0.896. Values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。把注入能量從 Linac2 的 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV，β·γ² 增加約一倍，同樣的工作點偏移可容納約兩倍粒子。改用帶兩個電子的 H⁻ 則可做電荷交換注入：剝離膜在環內把 H⁻ 變成質子，這是非保守的過程，新進束流可以疊放在已循環束流的相空間上而不受劉維定理限制，多圈累積時損失與發射度成長都比質子隔板注入小。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses. Raising injection energy from Linac2's 50 MeV to 160 MeV roughly doubles β·γ², so the same tune shift accommodates about twice the particles. Switching to H⁻ ions carrying two electrons enables charge-exchange injection: a stripping foil converts H⁻ to protons inside the ring, a non-conservative process that lets incoming beam be stacked onto the circulating beam's phase space without the Liouville constraint, so multi-turn accumulation produces less loss and emittance growth than proton septum injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Linac4 的主要目的是提高 LHC 的對撞能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Linac4's main purpose is to raise the LHC collision energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以質子質量 938.27 MeV 計：50 MeV 時 γ = 1.0533、β = 0.3139，β·γ² = 0.348；160 MeV 時 γ = 1.1703、β = 0.5195，β·γ² = 0.712。比值 0.712/0.348 = 2.04，在相同發射度與工作點偏移下，PSB 可接受的每環粒子數約為原來的 2.04 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the proton mass of 938.27 MeV: at 50 MeV γ = 1.0533 and β = 0.3139, so β·γ² = 0.348; at 160 MeV γ = 1.1703 and β = 0.5195, so β·γ² = 0.712. The ratio 0.712/0.348 = 2.04 means that at the same emittance and tune shift the PSB can accept about 2.04 times as many particles per ring. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 為何要 H⁻ 與 160 MeV：空間電荷與亮度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 PSB 以不同注入強度量測每環粒子數與橫向發射度，畫出亮度曲線（強度對發射度），與 Linac2 時代的曲線比較斜率；同時以工作點量測或模擬求空間電荷工作點偏移，確認在相同 ΔQ 下強度約增加一倍，並核對 LHC 注入所需的亮度目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the PSB measure particles per ring and transverse emittance at several injected intensities and plot the brightness curve of intensity versus emittance, comparing its slope with the Linac2-era curve; obtain the space-charge tune shift from tune measurements or simulation and confirm that intensity roughly doubles at the same ΔQ, then check against the brightness target required for LHC injection. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只提高直線加速器的流強而不提高注入能量，PSB 注入時空間電荷工作點偏移超過允許範圍，束流跨越整數或半整數共振，發射度成長並在環內損失，下游 LHC 的亮度目標無法達成，還造成環內活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising linac current without raising injection energy pushes the space-charge tune shift at PSB injection beyond its allowance, the beam crosses integer or half-integer resonances, emittance grows and particles are lost in the ring, so the LHC brightness target is missed and the ring is activated as well.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why H⁻ at 160 MeV: space charge and brightness"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.objective: 說明「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: Linac4 所有加速結構都在 352.2 MHz 工作，這也是 LEP 的頻率，讓它能沿用 LEP 的速調管與波導。粒子必須在每個加速間隙都遇到同一個 RF 相位：在 0 模的 Alvarez 型 DTL 中，相鄰間隙相距 βλ，即粒子在一個 RF 週期飛過的距離；在 π 模結構中相鄰單元相位相反，間距為 βλ/2。由於 β 從 0.08 增加到 0.52，單元沿線逐漸變長，每種結構只在某一 β 範圍內效率最高。同步相位取負值（例如 −20°），讓早到的粒子得到較少能量、晚到的得到較多，形成縱向聚焦，代價是能量增益乘以 cosφ_s。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All Linac4 structures run at 352.2 MHz, the LEP frequency, which lets the linac reuse LEP klystrons and waveguides. A particle must meet the same RF phase at every gap: in a 0-mode Alvarez DTL adjacent gaps are βλ apart, the distance travelled in one RF period, while in a π-mode structure adjacent cells are in opposite phase and spaced βλ/2. Because β grows from 0.08 to 0.52, cells lengthen along the linac and each structure type is most efficient only in a certain β range. The synchronous phase is negative, for example −20°, so early particles gain less energy and late ones more, giving longitudinal focusing at the cost of multiplying energy gain by cosφ_s. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: H⁻ 離子源、低能傳輸線與射頻四極加速器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: H⁻ ion source, LEBT and radio-frequency quadrupole: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Linac4 的離子源以數十 kW 的射頻加熱氫電漿，配合銫降低表面功函數以增加 H⁻ 產額，同時被引出的電子由偏轉磁場導到電子收集器，H⁻ 以 45 keV 引出。低能傳輸線以螺線管把束流匹配進 RFQ，殘氣電離產生的正離子部分中和空間電荷。3 m 長的 RFQ 把束流從 45 keV 加速到 3 MeV：四片電極的正弦調制同時提供與速度無關的電四極聚焦與縱向加速場，並把直流束流絕熱地聚束成 352.2 MHz 的微束團，這正是低 β 時磁聚焦無效、空間電荷最強時所需的功能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Linac4 source heats a hydrogen plasma with tens of kilowatts of RF and uses caesium to lower the surface work function and raise H⁻ yield, while co-extracted electrons are bent onto an electron dump and the H⁻ ions are extracted at 45 keV. The low-energy transport line matches the beam into the RFQ with solenoids, and positive ions from residual-gas ionisation partly neutralise space charge. The 3 m RFQ accelerates from 45 keV to 3 MeV: the sinusoidal modulation of its four vanes provides velocity-independent electric quadrupole focusing and a longitudinal accelerating field, and adiabatically bunches the DC beam into 352.2 MHz micro-bunches, exactly what is needed when magnetic focusing is weak at low β and space charge is strongest. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：45 keV 時 β = 0.00979，βλ = 8.3 mm；3 MeV 時 βλ = 67.9 mm，RFQ 單元長度增加八倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 45 keV β = 0.00979 and βλ = 8.3 mm; at 3 MeV βλ = 67.9 mm, so RFQ cells lengthen eightfold.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「RFQ 只負責加速，聚焦完全靠外部磁鐵。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The RFQ only accelerates; focusing is done entirely by external magnets." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: H⁻ 離子源、低能傳輸線與射頻四極加速器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: H⁻ ion source, LEBT and radio-frequency quadrupole: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：45 keV 時 β = 0.00979，βλ = 8.3 mm；3 MeV 時 βλ = 67.9 mm，RFQ 單元長度增加八倍。廣義導流係數 K = 2I/(I₀·(βγ)³)，I₀ = 4πε₀mc³/q ≈ 3.13×10⁷ A：I = 40 mA 時 45 keV 的 K = 2.7×10⁻³，3 MeV 降為 5.0×10⁻⁶，空間電荷影響減弱約 550 倍。RFQ 傳輸率 95% 時 40 mA 剩 38 mA。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 45 keV β = 0.00979 and βλ = 8.3 mm; at 3 MeV βλ = 67.9 mm, so RFQ cells lengthen eightfold. The generalised perveance K = 2I/(I₀·(βγ)³) with I₀ = 4πε₀mc³/q ≈ 3.13×10⁷ A is 2.7×10⁻³ for 40 mA at 45 keV but 5.0×10⁻⁶ at 3 MeV, weakening space charge about 550 times. At 95% RFQ transmission 40 mA becomes 38 mA. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離子源出口與 RFQ 出口各以束流變壓器量電流求傳輸率，並在低能傳輸線以狹縫—柵網發射度儀量測相空間；掃描 RFQ 電極電壓記錄傳輸率曲線，傳輸率開始飽和的電壓可反推實際電極電壓校正；長期記錄 H⁻ 電流、電子對 H⁻ 比與銫消耗，追蹤離子源狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure current with beam transformers at the source exit and RFQ exit to obtain transmission, and measure phase space in the LEBT with a slit-and-grid emittance meter; scan the RFQ vane voltage and record the transmission curve, whose saturation knee calibrates the actual vane voltage; log H⁻ current, electron-to-H⁻ ratio and caesium consumption over time to track source condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: H⁻ 離子源、低能傳輸線與射頻四極加速器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: H⁻ ion source, LEBT and radio-frequency quadrupole: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在離子源出口與 RFQ 出口各以束流變壓器量電流求傳輸率，並在低能傳輸線以狹縫—柵網發射度儀量測相空間；掃描 RFQ 電極電壓記錄傳輸率曲線，傳輸率開始飽和的電壓可反推實際電極電壓校正；長期記錄 H⁻ 電流、電子對 H⁻ 比與銫消耗，追蹤離子源狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure current with beam transformers at the source exit and RFQ exit to obtain transmission, and measure phase space in the LEBT with a slit-and-grid emittance meter; scan the RFQ vane voltage and record the transmission curve, whose saturation knee calibrates the actual vane voltage; log H⁻ current, electron-to-H⁻ ratio and caesium consumption over time to track source condition. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：銫覆蓋率漂移使 H⁻ 電流下降、共引出電子比例上升，引出區放電頻率增加而造成脈衝缺失；低能傳輸線匹配不當時 RFQ 傳輸率掉到八成以下，增加的發射度一路帶到 160 MeV，下游再怎麼調整也追不回亮度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Caesium coverage drift lowers H⁻ current and raises the co-extracted electron fraction, increasing extraction breakdowns and missing pulses; a poorly matched LEBT drops RFQ transmission below 80% and the added emittance is carried all the way to 160 MeV, where no downstream tuning can recover the brightness.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: H⁻ 離子源、低能傳輸線與射頻四極加速器：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 銫覆蓋率漂移使 H⁻ 電流下降、共引出電子比例上升，引出區放電頻率增加而造成脈衝缺失；低能傳輸線匹配不當時 RFQ 傳輸率掉到八成以下，增加的發射度一路帶到 160 MeV，下游再怎麼調整也追不回亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Caesium coverage drift lowers H⁻ current and raises the co-extracted electron fraction, increasing extraction breakdowns and missing pulses; a poorly matched LEBT drops RFQ transmission below 80% and the added emittance is carried all the way to 160 MeV, where no downstream tuning can recover the brightness. steps.title: 斬波線與三種加速結構的選擇：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Chopper line and the choice of three accelerating structures: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 3 MeV 的中能傳輸線上有靜電偏轉板斬波器，依 PSB 約 1 MHz 的 RF 桶結構移除特定微束團，約 65% 的束流保留，被移除的束團在 3 MeV 打到吸收器，那裡活化最小，避免它們在 PSB 捕獲時於 160 MeV 損失。斬波器上升時間必須短於 2.84 ns 的束團間距。之後 DTL 以漂移管內的永久磁鐵四極聚焦把能量提高到 50 MeV；50 到約 102 MeV 用七個模組的耦合腔 DTL，四極磁鐵放在腔外，便於對準與冷卻；102 到 160 MeV 用十二個 π 模結構，在 β 約 0.5 時有較高的有效分路阻抗。所有結構以 LEP 遺留的 352 MHz 速調管與新增速調管供電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 3 MeV medium-energy line carries an electrostatic deflecting-plate chopper that removes selected micro-bunches to match the roughly 1 MHz RF bucket pattern of the PSB, keeping about 65% of the beam; removed bunches hit an absorber at 3 MeV where activation is minimal instead of being lost at 160 MeV during PSB capture. The chopper rise time must be shorter than the 2.84 ns bunch spacing. The DTL then reaches 50 MeV with permanent-magnet quadrupoles inside its drift tubes; seven cell-coupled DTL modules take the beam from 50 to about 102 MeV with quadrupoles outside the cavities for easier alignment and cooling; twelve π-mode structures go from 102 to 160 MeV with higher effective shunt impedance near β ≈ 0.5. All structures are powered by reused LEP 352 MHz klystrons and newer klystrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chopper line, DTL, CCDTL and PIMS”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束團間距 1/352.2 MHz = 2.84 ns，每個 PSB RF 週期約 352 個束團，保留 65% 約 229 個、移除 123 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bunch spacing is 1/352.2 MHz = 2.84 ns, about 352 bunches per PSB RF period, so keeping 65% leaves about 229 and removes 123.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斬波器會浪費束流，所以越少用越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A chopper only wastes beam, so it should be used as little as possible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 斬波線與三種加速結構的選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chopper line and the choice of three accelerating structures: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chopper line, DTL, CCDTL and PIMS” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束團間距 1/352.2 MHz = 2.84 ns，每個 PSB RF 週期約 352 個束團，保留 65% 約 229 個、移除 123 個。斬波偏轉 θ = V·L/(2·W·d)：V = 800 V、L = 0.40 m、d = 20 mm、W = 3 MeV，θ ≈ 2.7 mrad，1 m 後偏移 2.7 mm 送入吸收器（數值為假設）。功率：10 MeV、5 m 的槽在 φ_s = −20° 需 V = 10.64 MV，ZT² = 30 MΩ/m 時銅耗 V²/(ZT²·L) = 0.75 MW，加 40 mA 束流功率 0.40 MW 共 1.15 MW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bunch spacing is 1/352.2 MHz = 2.84 ns, about 352 bunches per PSB RF period, so keeping 65% leaves about 229 and removes 123. Power: a 5 m tank gaining 10 MeV at φ_s = −20° needs V = 10.64 MV; with ZT² = 30 MΩ/m the copper loss V²/(ZT²·L) is 0.75 MW, plus 0.40 MW of 40 mA beam power for 1.15 MW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以快速束流變壓器與 BPM 和訊號觀察斬波後的束團圖樣，量測被移除時段的殘留粒子比例（消光比）；以低階 RF 系統記錄每個槽的振幅與相位在脈衝內的穩定度，確認束流負載補償使能量不隨脈衝下垂；永久磁鐵四極在安裝前逐顆量磁場梯度與磁中心。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe the chopped bunch pattern with fast current transformers and BPM sum signals and measure the residual particle fraction in the removed slots, the extinction ratio; record each tank's amplitude and phase stability within the pulse from the low-level RF system to confirm beam-loading compensation keeps energy from drooping along the pulse; measure gradient and magnetic centre of every permanent-magnet quadrupole before installation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斬波線與三種加速結構的選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chopper line and the choice of three accelerating structures"?
options: 以快速束流變壓器與 BPM 和訊號觀察斬波後的束團圖樣，量測被移除時段的殘留粒子比例（消光比）。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。
optionsEn: Observe the chopped bunch pattern with fast current transformers and BPM sum signals and measure the residual particle fraction in the removed slots, the extinction ratio.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive.
quiz.explanation: 以快速束流變壓器與 BPM 和訊號觀察斬波後的束團圖樣，量測被移除時段的殘留粒子比例（消光比）；以低階 RF 系統記錄每個槽的振幅與相位在脈衝內的穩定度，確認束流負載補償使能量不隨脈衝下垂；永久磁鐵四極在安裝前逐顆量磁場梯度與磁中心。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe the chopped bunch pattern with fast current transformers and BPM sum signals and measure the residual particle fraction in the removed slots, the extinction ratio; record each tank's amplitude and phase stability within the pulse from the low-level RF system to confirm beam-loading compensation keeps energy from drooping along the pulse; measure gradient and magnetic centre of every permanent-magnet quadrupole before installation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 斬波線與三種加速結構的選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chopper line and the choice of three accelerating structures: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Chopper line, DTL, CCDTL and PIMS” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 斬波消光不完全時，部分殘留的束團落在 PSB 的 RF 桶外，捕獲時在 160 MeV 損失並活化注入區；DTL 的永久磁鐵四極安裝後無法調整，若對準誤差在組裝時沒有抓出，只能靠修正磁鐵補償，並把殘留的軌道誤差帶到下游。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete chopper extinction leaves partial bunches outside the PSB RF buckets, where they are lost at 160 MeV during capture and activate the injection region; DTL permanent-magnet quadrupoles cannot be adjusted after installation, so an alignment error missed at assembly can only be compensated with corrector magnets and leaves residual orbit errors downstream. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所有結構以 LEP 遺留的 352 MHz 速調管與新增速調管供電。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All structures are powered by reused LEP 352 MHz klystrons and newer klystrons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斬波器會浪費束流，所以越少用越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A chopper only wastes beam, so it should be used as little as possible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斬波線與三種加速結構的選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chopper line and the choice of three accelerating structures" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斬波消光不完全時，部分殘留的束團落在 PSB 的 RF 桶外，捕獲時在 160 MeV 損失並活化注入區。
只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Incomplete chopper extinction leaves partial bunches outside the PSB RF buckets, where they are lost at 160 MeV during capture and activate the injection region.
Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy.
quiz.explanation: 斬波消光不完全時，部分殘留的束團落在 PSB 的 RF 桶外，捕獲時在 160 MeV 損失並活化注入區；DTL 的永久磁鐵四極安裝後無法調整，若對準誤差在組裝時沒有抓出，只能靠修正磁鐵補償，並把殘留的軌道誤差帶到下游。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」與「發射度成長、束流損失與 H⁻ 剝離預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration" and "Emittance growth, beam loss and H⁻ stripping budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「BPM 之間的飛行時間」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time of flight between BPMs” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。做法是讓某一腔的相位掃過 360°，同時以下游兩個束流位置監測器的相位訊號量測飛行時間，換算束流能量；把量到的能量對相位曲線與模擬的特徵曲線擬合，得到該腔的振幅與相位偏差。腔體依序調整，前一腔確定後作為下一腔的參考。H⁻ 還可以用雷射把多餘電子光剝離，做不攔截的束流剖面量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 之間的飛行時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line. One cavity's phase is swept through 360° while the time of flight between two downstream beam-position monitors is measured from their phase signals and converted to beam energy; fitting the measured energy-versus-phase curve to the simulated signature yields that cavity's amplitude and phase offsets. Cavities are set in sequence, each settled one serving as reference for the next. H⁻ beams also allow non-intercepting profile measurement by laser photodetachment of the extra electron. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Time of flight between BPMs”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩個 BPM 相距 L = 5 m、50 MeV（β = 0.3139）：t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns，即 18.71 個 RF 週期。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With two BPMs L = 5 m apart at 50 MeV (β = 0.3139), t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns, or 18.71 RF periods.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「BPM 之間的飛行時間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Time of flight between BPMs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration
knowledge.text: 每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。做法是讓某一腔的相位掃過 360°，同時以下游兩個束流位置監測器的相位訊號量測飛行時間，換算束流能量；把量到的能量對相位曲線與模擬的特徵曲線擬合，得到該腔的振幅與相位偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line. One cavity's phase is swept through 360° while the time of flight between two downstream beam-position monitors is measured from their phase signals and converted to beam energy; fitting the measured energy-versus-phase curve to the simulated signature yields that cavity's amplitude and phase offsets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration" is correct?
options: 只要把每個腔的 RF 功率調到最大，出口能量就會正確。
只要損失少於總束流的 1%，就不會造成問題。
每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。
optionsEn: Setting every cavity to maximum RF power guarantees the correct exit energy.
Losing less than 1% of the beam can never cause a problem.
Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line.
quiz.explanation: 每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「BPM 之間的飛行時間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time of flight between BPMs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩個 BPM 相距 L = 5 m、50 MeV（β = 0.3139）：t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns，即 18.71 個 RF 週期。能量增加 0.1 MeV 使 t 縮短 49 ps，在 352.2 MHz 相當於 6.2°；若相位量測解析度 0.5°，能量解析度約 0.1×0.5/6.2 ≈ 8 keV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With two BPMs L = 5 m apart at 50 MeV (β = 0.3139), t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns, or 18.71 RF periods. A 0.1 MeV energy increase shortens t by 49 ps, which is 6.2° at 352.2 MHz; with 0.5° phase resolution the energy resolution is about 0.1×0.5/6.2 ≈ 8 keV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個腔至少做兩次完整相位掃描，比較擬合得到的振幅與相位偏差是否在重複性範圍內；以終端的能譜磁鐵或已知能量點交叉檢查飛行時間的絕對能量；事先以標準訊號校正 BPM 電纜延遲與其溫度係數，並把參考時脈分配的相位漂移記入不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform at least two full phase scans per cavity and check that the fitted amplitude and phase offsets agree within repeatability; cross-check the absolute time-of-flight energy against an end-of-line spectrometer magnet or a known energy point; calibrate BPM cable delays and their temperature coefficients with reference signals beforehand, and include phase drift of the reference-clock distribution in the uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration", which statement holds?
options: 兩個 BPM 相距 L = 5 m、50 MeV（β = 0.3139）：t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns，即 18.71 個 RF 週期。
每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。
加速腔的電場一直朝前，粒子任何時候進入都會被加速。
optionsEn: With two BPMs L = 5 m apart at 50 MeV (β = 0.3139), t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns, or 18.71 RF periods.
If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too.
The cavity field always points forward, so particles are accelerated whenever they arrive.

quiz.explanationEn: With two BPMs L = 5 m apart at 50 MeV (β = 0.3139), t = L/(βc) = 53.13 ns, or 18.71 RF periods. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「BPM 之間的飛行時間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Time of flight between BPMs” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每個腔至少做兩次完整相位掃描，比較擬合得到的振幅與相位偏差是否在重複性範圍內；以終端的能譜磁鐵或已知能量點交叉檢查飛行時間的絕對能量；事先以標準訊號校正 BPM 電纜延遲與其溫度係數，並把參考時脈分配的相位漂移記入不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform at least two full phase scans per cavity and check that the fitted amplitude and phase offsets agree within repeatability; cross-check the absolute time-of-flight energy against an end-of-line spectrometer magnet or a known energy point; calibrate BPM cable delays and their temperature coefficients with reference signals beforehand, and include phase drift of the reference-clock distribution in the uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：BPM 電纜延遲隨溫度漂移 20 ps，對應約 2.5° 的相位誤差與約 40 keV 的能量誤讀，操作員據此把腔體相位設偏，束流偏離波峰進入下一段結構，縱向失配在高能段轉為損失；若沒有保存掃描結果，下次更換速調管後只能從頭重做。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 20 ps temperature drift in BPM cable delay corresponds to about 2.5° of phase and roughly 40 keV of misread energy, so operators set the cavity phase wrongly, the beam enters the next structure off crest and the longitudinal mismatch becomes losses at high energy; without saved scan results, every klystron replacement forces the procedure to start from scratch.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個腔至少做兩次完整相位掃描，比較擬合得到的振幅與相位偏差是否在重複性範圍內；以終端的能譜磁鐵或已知能量點交叉檢查飛行時間的絕對能量；事先以標準訊號校正 BPM 電纜延遲與其溫度係數，並把參考時脈分配的相位漂移記入不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Perform at least two full phase scans per cavity and check that the fitted amplitude and phase offsets agree within repeatability; cross-check the absolute time-of-flight energy against an end-of-line spectrometer magnet or a known energy point; calibrate BPM cable delays and their temperature coefficients with reference signals beforehand, and include phase drift of the reference-clock distribution in the uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相位掃描、飛行時間與 RF 設定點校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Phase scans, time of flight and RF set-point calibration"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每個腔至少做兩次完整相位掃描，比較擬合得到的振幅與相位偏差是否在重複性範圍內。
RFQ 只負責加速，聚焦完全靠外部磁鐵。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

steps.objective: 說明「發射度量測與束流損失監測器」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 亮度是流強除以發射度，設計要求在 PSB 注入處的正規化 rms 橫向發射度約 0.4 mm·mrad，沿線成長約 40%，其中約一半發生在斬波線。空間電荷失配與 RF 誤差會在束流周圍形成暈，暈粒子打到管壁成為損失；為了能人工維護，常用每公尺約 1 W 的損失上限。H⁻ 另有特有的損失途徑：與殘氣碰撞失去一個電子變成中性 H⁰，不再受四極磁鐵與偏轉磁鐵控制，沿直線飛到下一個轉彎處撞上真空管；束內碰撞與強磁場中的勞侖茲剝離則在更高能量才變得重要。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「發射度量測與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 某段真空因洩漏或除氣使壓力升高十倍，產生的 H⁰ 不受磁鐵偏轉，在下游第一個偏轉磁鐵處集中撞擊管壁，局部活化超出維護限制；斬波線準直偏差使發射度成長超出預算，PSB 的亮度目標因此落空，即使總傳輸率看起來正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A leak or outgassing that raises pressure tenfold in one section produces H⁰ that ignores the magnets and concentrates on the beam pipe at the first downstream dipole, pushing local activation beyond maintenance limits; a chopper-line misalignment that grows emittance beyond budget makes the PSB miss its brightness target even though overall transmission looks normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：H⁻ 另有特有的損失途徑：與殘氣碰撞失去一個電子變成中性 H⁰，不再受四極磁鐵與偏轉磁鐵控制，沿直線飛到下一個轉彎處撞上真空管；束內碰撞與強磁場中的勞侖茲剝離則在更高能量才變得重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: H⁻ has its own loss channels: a collision with residual gas strips one electron to make neutral H⁰, which no longer responds to quadrupoles or dipoles and flies straight into the vacuum pipe at the next bend; intra-beam stripping and Lorentz stripping in strong magnetic fields matter only at higher energies.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要損失少於總束流的 1%，就不會造成問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。每個環的注入區以局部軌道凸起讓 H⁻ 與循環質子會合，H⁻ 穿過薄碳膜時兩個電子被剝離，變成質子留在環內；未完全剝離的 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 被導向內部吸收器。注入期間逐步改變凸起高度做橫向相空間塗佈，以得到目標發射度與分布；但循環質子每圈都可能再穿過碳膜，引起多重庫侖散射、核反應損失與碳膜加熱，因此塗佈與凸起收回時序必須讓穿膜次數最少。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. In each ring a local orbit bump brings the H⁻ beam alongside the circulating protons, and on crossing a thin carbon foil both electrons are stripped, leaving protons that stay in the ring; partially stripped H⁰ and unstripped H⁻ are steered to an internal dump. The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：PSB 周長 2π×25 m = 157.08 m，160 MeV 質子 β = 0.5195，迴轉頻率 βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz，與斬波的約 1 MHz 圖樣一致。每環注入 100 µs 約 99 圈；25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ 個質子（教學假設）；若剝離效率 98%，每環有 3.1×10¹¹ 個粒子送往 H⁰ 吸收器。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The PSB circumference is 2π×25 m = 157.08 m; at 160 MeV a proton has β = 0.5195 and revolution frequency βc/C = 0.5195×2.998×10⁸/157.08 = 0.992 MHz, matching the roughly 1 MHz chopping pattern. A 100 µs injection per ring spans about 99 turns; 25 mA × 100 µs = 2.5 µC = 1.56×10¹³ protons as a teaching assumption, and at 98% stripping efficiency 3.1×10¹¹ particles per ring go to the H⁰ dump. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Charge-exchange injection, stripping foil and phase-space painting: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以吸收器上的電流監測器量測 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 比例，求剝離效率並追蹤其隨碳膜使用時間的變化；以環內束流變壓器比較注入粒子數與循環粒子數；以線掃描器量注入後的橫向分布與發射度，與塗佈設定比較；定期以攝影機檢視碳膜外觀並記錄更換紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the H⁰ and H⁻ fractions with current monitors on the dump to obtain stripping efficiency and track how it evolves with foil age; compare injected and circulating particle numbers with ring beam transformers; measure post-injection transverse distributions and emittance with wire scanners against the painting settings; inspect the foil periodically with a camera and keep a replacement log. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 電荷交換注入、剝離膜與相空間塗佈：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 碳膜因長期加熱而變薄或出現針孔，剝離效率下降，更多 H⁰ 打到吸收器使其過熱並增加注入區損失；塗佈設定錯誤讓循環束流反覆穿膜，發射度成長並在環內產生持續損失，PSB 亮度反而比設計低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A foil thinned by prolonged heating or pierced by pinholes loses stripping efficiency, sending more H⁰ to the dump, overheating it and raising injection-region losses; wrong painting settings make the circulating beam cross the foil repeatedly, growing emittance and creating persistent ring losses so that PSB brightness ends up below design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剝離膜越厚越好，因為剝離一定最完全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thicker stripping foil is always better because stripping becomes complete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」如何決定CERN Linac4 直線加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reliability run and handoff record” determines the key performance of “CERN Linac4 linear accelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。整機可用率是串聯子系統可用率的乘積，所以離子源、每一座 RF 站、真空、電源與控制都要分配可用率預算。交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. Overall availability is the product of series subsystem availabilities, so source, every RF station, vacuum, power supplies and controls each receive an availability budget. The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reliability run and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reliability run and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設 20 座 RF 站各有 99.5% 可用率：0.995²⁰ = 0.905，再乘以離子源 0.99 得 0.896；若每站提升到 99.8%，0.998²⁰ = 0.961，乘以 0.99 得 0.951。可見在串聯系統中，每站僅 0.3% 的改善就讓整機可用率提高約 5.5 個百分點。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 20 RF stations each at 99.5% availability: 0.995²⁰ = 0.905, and with a 0.99 source the total is 0.896; raising each station to 99.8% gives 0.998²⁰ = 0.961 and 0.951 with the source. In a series system a 0.3% improvement per station thus lifts overall availability by about 5.5 percentage points. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：量測與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reliability run and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時沒有保存各腔的相位掃描參考與離子源參數，某座速調管更換後操作團隊無法快速恢復設定點，停機時間拉長；離子源銫消耗的緩慢變化沒有被記錄，強度逐週下降被誤判為 RF 問題，排查方向錯誤而延誤修復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without saved phase-scan references and source parameters in the handoff, a klystron replacement leaves operations unable to restore set points quickly and downtime stretches; an unlogged slow change in source caesium consumption causes a week-by-week intensity decline that is misdiagnosed as an RF problem, sending troubleshooting the wrong way and delaying repair.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收項目：以飛行時間與能譜磁鐵確認出口能量 160 MeV；量測自離子源到 PIMS 出口的傳輸率並與設計的約 85% 比較；在注入處量發射度；記錄脈衝長度、斬波圖樣與損失地圖；以故障紀錄統計平均故障間隔與平均修復時間，計算各子系統可用率並與預算表比較。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance items: confirm 160 MeV exit energy by time of flight and spectrometer magnet; measure transmission from source to PIMS exit against the design value of about 85%; measure emittance at injection; record pulse length, chopping pattern and loss map; derive mean time between failures and mean time to repair from the fault log, compute each subsystem's availability and compare with the budget table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 分段試運轉、可靠度與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged commissioning, reliability and operations handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reliability run and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時沒有保存各腔的相位掃描參考與離子源參數，某座速調管更換後操作團隊無法快速恢復設定點，停機時間拉長；離子源銫消耗的緩慢變化沒有被記錄，強度逐週下降被誤判為 RF 問題，排查方向錯誤而延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without saved phase-scan references and source parameters in the handoff, a klystron replacement leaves operations unable to restore set points quickly and downtime stretches; an unlogged slow change in source caesium consumption causes a week-by-week intensity decline that is misdiagnosed as an RF problem, sending troubleshooting the wrong way and delaying repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統可用率都很高，整機可用率就一定很高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every subsystem is highly available, the whole machine must be too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
